title: Require Plans for Agent Snapshots
summary: Agent-facing snapshot completion now refuses unplanned product records. MCP complete_snapshot and CLI eve commit require a locked Plan reference unless dirty-tree validation fails first, so agents cannot bypass declare_plan and silently create no_plan snapshots.
userVisibleChange: Agents now get a clear error when they try to complete an EVE snapshot without passing the locked planId and planRevision from declare_plan.

risks.title: Post-hoc plan base for this recording
risks.mitigation: The implementation commit and verification are recorded in the snapshot; future records are now enforced before completion through the agent-facing gate.

timeline.title: Added locked-plan guard
timeline.summary: Shared requireAgentPlanReference across MCP complete_snapshot and CLI eve commit.

timeline.title: Added regression coverage
timeline.summary: Tests now verify missing-plan refusals and update planned happy-path fixtures.

decisions.title: Gate agent-facing completion paths
decisions.rationale: Keeping the low-level snapshot writer able to represent no_plan records preserves historical/import behavior, while MCP and CLI paths now enforce the agent workflow.

decisions.title: Preserve dirty-tree error precedence
decisions.rationale: Existing diagnostics remain more actionable when implementation files are dirty and allowDirty was not set.
